column2: slub: allocate private object map for debugfs listings

column1: Slub has a static spinlock protected bitmap for marking which objects are on
freelist when it wants to list them
allocating such map can lead to recursion or locking issues
The handlers of debugfs files alloc_traces and free_traces also currently use this

column2: but their syscall context makes it straightforward to allocate a

column1: private map before entering locked sections
